verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents token streaming, SSE or WebSocket event streams, or real-time delivery of tool-call and step events to a UI. Lifecycle callbacks for logging and monitoring, the REST API server, and the dev Web UI are adjacent building blocks, not a documented streaming-output capability. The event-filtering mention concerns context management, not streaming.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream tokens and intermediate agent events (tool calls, steps) to my UI in real time
